symptom: HTML loads but boot can remain trapped on 'Despertando a Divina Bruxa…'.
root_causes: PWA V324 MutationObserver rewrote aria-hidden on the same observed elements without checking whether the value changed, allowing a microtask feedback loop.
AccountWorld V319 observed childList changes while its own enhance() removed/reinserted the V319 panel, creating a second possible feedback loop after authenticated account rerenders.
Legacy index bootstrap still requests sw.js?v=208, so the hotfix PWA explicitly re-registers the fixed worker after load with updateViaCache=none.
fixes: Restore equality guard before setting aria-hidden.
Ignore AccountWorld mutations produced only by its own panel.
Move Service Worker caches to V325 and force fixed registration.
Cache-bust the PWA module from app-v208.js.
Fail-open the boot loader only after critical V180 CSS has been verified, preventing permanent loader lock after recoverable navigation errors.
